title: About EnerMAN Technologies Pvt Ltd: Solar SCADA, Bengaluru
description: EnerMAN Technologies builds IoT SCADA, RMS and plant controllers for solar plants in Bengaluru. Hardware, firmware, cloud and mobile apps made in-house.
heading: About EnerMAN: solar SCADA, RMS and IoT hardware, built in Bengaluru

blocks.text: About EnerMAN: solar SCADA, RMS and IoT hardware, built in Bengaluru
EnerMAN Technologies builds IoT SCADA and remote monitoring systems for solar power plants, from Bengaluru, deployed across 3+ GW in 10+ countries.

blocks.alt: An open EnerMAN panel cabinet: rows of EnerMAN units and wiring

blocks.text: An EnerMAN panel cabinet, built in-house.
Hardware, firmware, cloud platform and mobile apps, all developed in-house

We build IoT-based SCADA and remote monitoring systems for solar and hybrid power plants. Plant owners, EPCs, IPPs, O&M providers and utilities use them to monitor, control and analyse their assets in real time, across utility-scale, industrial and commercial projects, rooftops and agri-solar.
Seven products cover cloud and local SCADA, power plant control, data logging, load management and DG synchronisation, zero export and generation forecasting.
Provide innovative digital products to manage energy and decarbonize the world
Provide IoT-based monitoring, control and forecasting products at an affordable price to the renewable energy industry, in support of its net zero goal

Team EnerMAN has hands-on experience in building and operating several MWs of solar PV plants. That experience went into one platform that saves energy, reduces opex and improves plant performance, and the team has been building solar energy technology for more than a decade.

blocks.alt: Ashok D M, CEO and Managing Director, EnerMAN Technologies

blocks.text: Ashok has spent more than three decades in power, semiconductors and telecom, including 16+ years in solar PV. He co-founded AVI Solar Energy in 2010 and EnerMAN in 2019, after roles as General Manager at Sasken and Project Manager at Wipro, with earlier engagements at Microcon and Enercon.

blocks.alt: Nithin B, Director of Finance, EnerMAN Technologies

blocks.text: Nithin is a Chartered Accountant (1988 batch) with more than three decades in finance, accounts, taxation and corporate governance in the manufacturing industry. Before AVI Solar and EnerMAN he worked at Larsen & Toubro in India and China. He co-founded EnerMAN and directs its finance function.

blocks.alt: Ravi Shanker, VP, Business Development, EnerMAN Technologies

blocks.text: Ravi leads business development at EnerMAN. He brings more than 25 years in business development, commercial and operations roles across EPC, energy, infrastructure and industrial automation, with earlier assignments at Sinicon Controls, Moat Project Management, Dynamics Group, Infidea FZE, Bin Galib Group, Reliance Communication and Powertek Associates.

blocks.alt: Jithesh Dev, Advisor, Business Development, EnerMAN Technologies

blocks.text: Jithesh has 25+ years in renewable energy, laser optics and research, including 19+ years in the renewable industry across solar, wind, BESS, hydro and microgrids. His prior engagements include ACWA Power, GEC JSC/TTC Energy, Conergy Asia, Phoenix Solar, SERIS, REC and Tata-BP.

Our 30+ professionals bring decades of combined experience in solar power automation, industrial systems, embedded technology and cloud-based monitoring platforms, and work from dedicated workstations at our Bengaluru office.

blocks.alt: An EnerMAN panel being assembled at the Bengaluru office

blocks.text: PCB design, firmware programming and real-time hardware testing.
Real-time monitoring interfaces, simulation setups and redundancy testing.
API development, cloud dashboards and mobile app integration.
Bring your solar plants to one screen.
For IPPs, EPCs, utilities, rooftop owners, agri-solar and O&M providers.
